home.faq.title: Frequently asked questions
home.faq.1.question: How do I buy tickets?
home.faq.1.answer: Simply search for an event, select your tickets, and complete the secure checkout process.
home.faq.2.question: Can I get a refund?
home.faq.2.answer: Refund policies are set by event organizers. Please check the event details before purchasing.
home.faq.3.question: How do I check in?
home.faq.3.answer: Show your QR code ticket at the event entrance. Staff will scan it for quick entry.
home.faq.4.question: Do I need an account?
home.faq.4.answer: Yes, you need a free account to purchase tickets and manage your bookings.
